name: @kitelet/core
description: A teaching toolkit for small, self-contained web apps. HTML is enough for small things.

scripts.build: npx -y esbuild src/kite.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=Kite "--footer:js=if(typeof window!=='undefined'){window.Kite=Kite.default||Kite;}if(typeof globalThis!=='undefined'){globalThis.Kite=globalThis.Kite?.default||globalThis.Kite;}" --outfile=dist/kite.min.js && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { fs.copyFileSync('src/styles/kite.css', 'dist/kite.css'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/kite.min.js', 'docs/assets/kite.min.js'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/kite.css', 'docs/assets/kite.css'); })"

author: Kite Contributors
